title: Big Bold Creamy Strawberry Jam & Clotted Cream 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Creamy Nic Salts Strawberry Jam & Clotted Cream brings together the luscious taste of sweet strawberry jam with the rich, indulgent flavour of clotted cream. This delightful dessert-inspired e-liquid delivers a smooth and satisfying vaping experience, ideal for those who love rich and fruity flavours with a creamy twist. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Big Bold Nic Salts are designed for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter kits and refillable pod devices . Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for a fast, satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love this flavour, there are several other flavours to try from Big Bold’s collection, including Menthols, Creamy and Fruity flavours. Explore such beguiling blends as Honey Melon, Banana Milk, and Vanilla Custard for a Big Bold burst of flavour and a taste sensation like no other.
